tools.description: Ranks the four Walt Disney World theme parks for visiting right now, combining live crowd levels, today's forecast and remaining park hours. Returns each park's rank, live average wait, open/close times and a one-line reason. With resort "dlr" it ranks Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure

tools.name: get_live_wait_times
tools.description: Current posted wait times for Walt Disney World attractions plus SupaPark's Real Wait estimate of the actual wait, a low/high range, confidence, and a flag for "ghost" waits that are posted but not real. Refreshes every few minutes during park hours. Disneyland Resort is covered too: park disneyland

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Shows whether this assistant is linked to a SupaPark account, the plan (free, silver or gold) and how alerts are delivered. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_live_wait_times · Public sink: get_dining_drop_odds, get_hardest_dining_reservations · Destructive: get_dining_drop_odds, remove_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_live_wait_times · Public sink: get_dining_drop_odds, get_hardest_dining_reservations · Destructive: get_dining_drop_odds, remove_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_dining_drop_odds" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
